entities.summary: Oleh Ihorovych Makhnitskyi is a Ukrainian politician and lawyer who was an MP of Ukraine for the 7th Convocation of the Verkhovna Rada as a member of "Svoboda". In addition, from 24 February 2014 to 18 June 2014, he served as Acting Prosecutor General of Ukraine under Petro Poroshenko, until he was replaced by Vitaly Yarema.
